item.summary: fix(ui): fill collapsed progress-card hover to the composer edge (#129869) Collapsed, the composer progress card's hover highlight painted only the band, leaving slivers of the resting background in the underlap strip and the arcs beside the composer's rounded corners. Move the collapsed hover fill to the card container (clipped to the full rounded shape, extending under the composer) and keep the summary-scoped fill for the expanded state.
